title: The Corpus Pane learning loop
plainLanguage: The program gets stronger because every reviewed video leaves behind reusable examples, corrections, visibility decisions, and explanations of differences. The next video can search that history before starting from scratch.
purpose: Define what “learning” means for this project without claiming automatic neural retraining.

rules.statement: Learning means accumulating structured, queryable, reviewed evidence unless a later pass explicitly adds model retraining.
For each new source: ingest → clean → draft track → retrieve references → correct → classify differences → verify bounded scopes → save reusable configurations.
Measure improvement by reduced correction effort, better reference retrieval, fewer repeated mistakes, and clearer gap detection—not by library size alone.
Unverified guesses must never be promoted into the trusted reference pool merely because they are old.

implementation.currentSupport: The evidence accumulation and reference search portions already exist.
implementation.futureWork: Add explicit per-video “benefit from prior knowledge” metrics and gap summaries.
